arguments.summary: Tenant offered £100/month towards £3,700 arrears and attached a standard Breathing Space notice from 01/10/2026. I paused arrears activity (noted), replied to tenant and adviser without accepting the plan, and escalated to legal to stop the scheduled SMS and Section 8 draft.

answers.question: 1. What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: A standard Breathing Space (from 01/10/2026) covers the £3,700 arrears. We cannot chase the arrears with the tenant, take enforcement action or serve/draft Section 8 or other arrears notices. The scheduled arrears SMS (12/10) and Section 8 draft review (14/10) must not go ahead. Current rent and repair contact continue. Contact the tenant started is fine to acknowledge, and arrears talks go through the adviser.

answers.question: 2. Can you accept the proposed payment plan?
answers.answer: No. Payment plans need a human and the landlord's agreement. I only acknowledged it. At £100/month it would take about 37 months, so it needs a considered decision, via the adviser.

answers.question: 3. What actions and communications, to whom?
answers.answer: Note on tenant account (A1, applied though API errored); escalation to legal P2 ESC-102 (A2); acknowledgement email to Daniel (A3, sent on retry); email to adviser Ruth Okoye (A4). The landlord has not been messaged yet; legal to put the plan to him.

details.summary: Tenant offered £100/month towards £3,700 arrears and attached a standard Breathing Space notice from 01/10/2026. I paused arrears activity (noted), replied to tenant and adviser without accepting the plan, and escalated to legal to stop the scheduled SMS and Section 8 draft.

answers.question: 1. What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: A standard Breathing Space (from 01/10/2026) covers the £3,700 arrears. We cannot chase the arrears with the tenant, take enforcement action or serve/draft Section 8 or other arrears notices. The scheduled arrears SMS (12/10) and Section 8 draft review (14/10) must not go ahead. Current rent and repair contact continue. Contact the tenant started is fine to acknowledge, and arrears talks go through the adviser.

answers.question: 2. Can you accept the proposed payment plan?
answers.answer: No. Payment plans need a human and the landlord's agreement. I only acknowledged it. At £100/month it would take about 37 months, so it needs a considered decision, via the adviser.

answers.question: 3. What actions and communications, to whom?
answers.answer: Note on tenant account (A1, applied though API errored); escalation to legal P2 ESC-102 (A2); acknowledgement email to Daniel (A3, sent on retry); email to adviser Ruth Okoye (A4). The landlord has not been messaged yet; legal to put the plan to him.
